ns2:course.label: Real Analysis
ns2:course.description: Lebesgue measure on the real line; integration and differentiation of real valued functions of a real variable; and additional topics at discretion of instructor. Prerequisite: MATH 447 or equivalent.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign. Not intended for MS:Economics:Policy Econ -UIUC, MS:Economics:Policy Econ -UIUC, or MS: Financial Engineering.
